node.statement: Exact fixed-term defect identities: bilinearity and the exact two-sided unit from def-epsilon-cstar-algebra give P bold-dot P-P=(A bold-dot A-J)/4 and Q bold-dot Q-Q=P bold-dot P-P. Moreover A bold-dot A-U^dagger bold-dot U=(A-U^dagger) bold-dot A+U^dagger bold-dot(A-U), while ||A-U||=||A-U^dagger||=||U-U^dagger||/2.
